integrity: Algebraic proof and standalone finite-field crosschecks; independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniformly independent weights are assumed; fields must admit the representation. Irreducible components are of the reduced geometric commuting-pair variety. Ordered tuples, not conjugacy classes, are enumerated. Originality retains residual historical priority risk.
title: Uniform-weight metabelian Lie algebras: commuting counts and a sharp reducibility threshold
